+PX_M = 0.00022186
+PAPER_X_FAR = 0.0136
+PAPER_Y_LEFT = 0.1136

+def current_pose(r):
+    return np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], dtype=float)
+
+
+def sampled_poses(start, end, max_step=0.003, dt=0.05):
+    """Linear xyz move at ≤60 mm/s nominal; keep quaternion fixed downward."""
+    start = np.asarray(start, dtype=float)
+    end = np.asarray(end, dtype=float)
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(end[:3] - start[:3]) / max_step)))
+    t = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n + 1)[1:, None]
+    xyz = start[None, :3] + t * (end[None, :3] - start[None, :3])
+    quat = np.tile(DOWN, (n, 1))
+    return np.concatenate([xyz, quat], axis=1)
+
+
+def goto(r, xyz, max_step=0.003):
+    start = current_pose(r)
+    end = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), DOWN]
+    poses = sampled_poses(start, end, max_step=max_step)
+    if len(poses):
+        return r.submit("ee_pose", poses, dt=0.05, video="none")
+    return None
